title: Dia Browser features
description: A calm feature bento on cream under a centred serif heading: transparent cards with 20px corners and a fine dark outline, set 7/5 then 5/7 then 7/5 on desktop and stacked on phones. Each holds a small uppercase tag in a white pill, a light 20px paragraph, and a product shot sitting on the bottom edge that fades out into the card. Cards fade in as they enter the window.
notes: set wide on the first card of rows 1 and 3 and the second of row 2 for the original's zig-zag
media per card is a placeholder for a product shot; cards are at least 630px tall on desktop
name: diabrowser-features
